Agreement with the uploaded hypnogram.

``all`` scores every epoch the hypnogram labels. ``benchmark`` keeps only epochs within
30 minutes of scored sleep, the window used for the metrics published in the A2 report.
All epochs as column arrays: ``stages[i]`` and ``probabilities[i]`` describe epoch ``i``.

100 Hz in microvolts, exactly as the models saw it.

post.description:
Upload a recording, optionally with its hypnogram, and queue the selected models.

Uploading the same file again returns the existing recording and only queues models
that have not been run on it yet.

200.description: This file was uploaded before; it is reused.

delete.description: Delete an uploaded recording with its jobs, predictions and files.

get.description: Thirty seconds of the filtered EEG that the models saw, at 100 Hz in microvolts.

The ``k`` library epochs nearest to one epoch of this recording, in one space.

A model space compares the features that model's fold saved with this recording's
result, so the model must have been run here; the signal space needs only the
preprocessing done by the first job. When the recording is itself a library night,
neighbours from its participant are left out: they would include the epoch itself.
